podcast.title: Iconic Trainspotting Opening (1996)
podcast.body: Ewan McGregor, portraying the character Renton in the 1996 film *Trainspotting*, starred in the movie's iconic opening scene. In this memorable sequence, Renton and his friends are shown running from the police, set to the energizing sound of Iggy Pop's "Lust for Life." "The opening scene is iconic, with Renton played by you and McGregor, and his mates running from the cops while Iggy Pops lust for life plays."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Lust for Life in Trainspotting Opening (1996)
xref.body: Iggy Pop's song "Lust for Life" famously plays during the iconic opening scene of the 1996 film *Trainspotting*, where Renton (Ewan McGregor) and his friends are running from the police. Its placement significantly contributes to the film's memorable start and the soundtrack's overall impact. "The opening scene is iconic, with Renton played by you and McGregor, and his mates running from the cops while Iggy Pops lust for life plays."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
